pages.text: Install a capacitor and supply a solid furnace fuel such as coal or charcoal. The generator ignites fresh fuel when its buffer has room and the redstone setting allows it. Fuel that leaves a container, such as a lava bucket, stays out of the fuel slot.

Point a Push face toward a machine that accepts FE, or connect an Energy Conduit. A burning fuel item keeps ticking down if the buffer fills or a redstone signal prevents new fuel from starting. Add a $(l:enderio:power/banks)Capacitor Bank$(/l) to store more of a burn between jobs.
